scientific_integrity: The symbolic proof is supplied, along with independently reconstructed original-identity computations for four finite fields. Finite checks are not general proofs. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers rank-at-most-one square-zero algebraic Nijenhuis operators on split sl_2 in characteristic not two; finite-field enumeration requires odd field order; component statements concern reduced varieties. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Commuting square-zero rank-one Nijenhuis operators on \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\): exact counts and component growth
